why_this_fixture: A generation whose history tail reaches all the way back to serial 1 — nothing has fallen off it. It carries no component or capability rows on purpose: what it exists to pin is generation IDENTITY (design doc §3.3a), which is what `cases/accountability.yaml` reads it for, and an empty row set keeps that case set honest about what it is testing. The zero rows below are therefore the expectation, not an omission; the content_hash check that runs beside them is the part that matters here, because the tail sits inside the hashed body and a Rust implementation that serialized it differently would fail exactly here.
